first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The slender long gun held by Person A, with a mottled gray-black surface and a protruding component on the front, extending from the bottom of the image toward the upper left.

entities.name: muddy shell-cratered ground
entities.identification: Uneven dark muddy ground extending from the foreground to the midground, containing low-lying areas, gravel, and scattered wreckage.

entities.name: cluster of ruined walls and rubble
entities.identification: A collection of gray-black ruined brick-and-stone walls from the near ground to the background, with damaged wall tops and openings remaining in some sections.

entities.name: cluster of dead trees
entities.identification: A collection of leafless vegetation including nearby thin-branched shrubs and distant tall, slender tree trunks.

entities.name: smoke-cloud-filled sky
entities.identification: A background of gray-white, dark gray, and gray-green to yellow-green smoke clouds behind the buildings and tree trunks, with bright skylight in some areas.

entities.name: orange point of fire
entities.identification: A collection of orange-yellow flames and nearby bright points in multiple places among the ruins and ground wreckage.

entities.name: damaged vertical flag
entities.identification: Alternating dark and light flag fabric hanging from a slender vertical pole, gathered and drooping, with uneven edges.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The person holding Weapon A from a first-person viewpoint, with only parts of the dark-gloved hands clearly discernible.

entities.name: shell-crater water
entities.identification: Irregular gray-green water in a low area of the muddy ground, with pale bright reflections and dark reflections on its surface.
